background.value: White background -- 'Two color passport photos on a white background'

validity.value: Photo must be less than three (3) months old at time of application

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Embassy of Haiti in Washington, D.C. (haiti.org), the most authoritative Haitian diplomatic page located during this research pass; a separate Direction de l'Immigration et Emigration (DIE) technical specification page could not be found. The page was fetched directly and confirms only 'two color passport photos on a white background, less than three (3) months old.' DB's background value (white) matches exactly -- no conflict. No precise size, head-height ratio, or composition rules (expression, glasses, headwear, ears, clothing, accessories) are published on this official page, so those fields remain unverified rather than sourced to non-official passport-photo vendor sites (printitsmart.com, passportphotonow.com, vividphoto.com, etc. were all excluded per the truthfulness gate).
